sources.title: JamesQuartz/qt-VI.1.3-32k · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 32,000-token multilingual byte-level tokenizer covering the full FLORES-200 set (204 languages, 27+ scripts) with zero coverage failures. VI.1.3 reads as 6.1.3 in Quartz notation (the leading Roman V is the numeral 5, so the VI generation is 6).
